meta_description: Bubble mosaic tiles for bathroom walls: a 3x3 inch blend of round ceramic disks for showers, splashbacks and accent walls. Free sample on WhatsApp.
description:
These bubble mosaic tiles for bathroom walls are a blend of round ceramic disks, listed at 3 x 3 inches, made for shower walls, vanity splashbacks and small accent panels.

## How they look
Round disks of different sizes sit together like bubbles, and the word "blend" in the name means the pieces mix rather than repeat in one size or tone. Circles break up a wall more softly than squares or hexagons, so the finish tends to feel playful and light. Confirm the exact colours of the blend on a sample, since this page does not list them yet.

## Where they work
- **Shower niches and walls**, where round disk mosaic tiles bend around corners and edges easily.
- **Behind a basin**, as a splashback strip against plain white or grey wall tiles.
- **A powder room feature wall**, where a small area of penny round ceramic mosaic gives a lot of character.

Ceramic mosaic is a common choice for wet areas because the surface is generally simple to wipe clean; the many grout joints also add grip when used on a shower floor, if your fixer confirms it suits floors.

## Good to know
- Size: 3 x 3 inches (as listed)
- Material: ceramic mosaic, round disk blend
- Category: bathroom wall mosaic tiles

Round mosaic has more grout than square tile, so pick a grout colour you are happy to see, and seal it once cured. A soft brush keeps the joints clean.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to check the 3x3 mosaic tiles against your fittings, then get a dated quote. More designs are in the [bathroom wall mosaic range](/categories/bathroom-wall-tiles-mosaic) and the [bathroom and kitchen tile ideas](/blog/bathroom-and-kitchen-tiles-modern-designs-and-backsplash-ideas) guide.

faqs.q: What is the price of bubble mosaic tiles for bathroom walls?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Are bubble mosaic tiles good for a shower?
faqs.a: Ceramic mosaic is widely used on shower walls. Use a waterproof adhesive and seal the grout after it cures; ask your fixer before using any mosaic on a shower floor.

faqs.q: Bubble mosaic or hexagon mosaic: which is easier to keep clean?
faqs.a: Hexagon mosaic usually has fewer, straighter grout lines; round bubble mosaic has more grout around each disk, so it needs a little more brushing but looks softer.
